mentions.name: Telox
mentions.description: An independent LaTeX engine written in Rust with no C dependencies. It aims to support bidirectional editing of LaTeX output — letting users drag objects around and interact with typeset pages — with realtime edits in the ~10 millisecond ballpark, in service of mathematical exposition.
mentions.problem: There is currently no way to invert LaTeX engine output for bidirectional editing, so users cannot easily drag objects around or interact with the page in LaTeX.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a new independent LaTeX engine written in Rust and no C dependencies at all. You can see it working at https://telox.dev/app/scratchpad/

There's currently not a way to invert LaTeX engine output for bidirectional editing. So you can't easily drag objects around or interact with the page on LaTeX.
mentions.author: eigenblake
